snippet.title: Oddbat - Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Can’t wait to sink your teeth into Oddbat? Play our demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818910/

Welcome to the eerie world of Oddbat, a precision platformer with a bite!

Become a bat and explore an open world packed with deadly challenges, with over 1,000 screens to dash and dodge your way through. Seek out unsuspecting victims to satisfy your thirst for blood whilst also finding adorable pets to smooch. There are no upgrades, no powerups, just your tiny bat self against the world.
